title: Retro games component diagram
description: The games folder groups five independent browser games, each its own npm project with its own Cloudflare Worker. Four have an engine, a page and a replay-checked high-score table; Gambit is a Godot client whose Worker handles sign-in, games and history. They share no code at build time, and three carry identical copies of the online module.

components.name: Retro games
components.responsibility: The five browser games, side by side.

components.name: Rally
components.responsibility: Table tennis against the computer, or a friend online on their own device.

components.name: Hivestorm
components.responsibility: An arcade shooter for one player, or two online taking turns.

components.name: Shatterbelt
components.responsibility: A rock-breaking shooter for one pilot, or up to nine online, co-op or versus.

components.name: Samosa
components.responsibility: A remake of a 1983 ZX Spectrum strategy game, played screen by screen.

components.name: Gambit
components.responsibility: 3D chess in Godot: friends invited by email and played at their own pace with chat, or Stockfish at eight strengths; every game kept and replayable.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: The games hub at icelander.net/games (the recreations repository's Worker): sign-in, /me, the multiplayer lobby and one WebSocket relay per online match.
